title: OneDrive: Create or upload button moves to the right side of the page on the web
summary: Hold: Microsoft confirms the button move and unchanged create and upload options, but does not state the briefing's broader assurances that data access and permissions are unchanged. The rollout, licensing and absence of a documented placement control check out; narrow the unsupported assurances and keep the completion date explicitly tentative.

claims.fix: Replace 'no data or permissions change' in Why it matters with 'Microsoft says the available create and upload options are unchanged'. Replace the Data exposure bullet with 'The notice states that the available options for creating files and folders or uploading content are unchanged.'
